checks: Confirm the active medication list: two simvastatin entries are active (10 mg started 2026-08-16 and 20 mg started 2020-07-11). Check whether this is a duplicate or an intended dose change, and whether the 20 mg entry was stopped or should be reconciled. Verify with the prescriber and pharmacy fill history; do not infer intent.

Review medication starts and stops in the window 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30, including any change to the simvastatin entries, and confirm adherence to metoprolol succinate, clopidogrel, and nitroglycerin spray (check refill gaps and whether the nitroglycerin supply is current and not expired).

Ischemic heart disease: check for chest pain, nitroglycerin use, ED visits, urgent care visits, admissions, or cardiology contacts in the window. Review blood pressure and heart rate trends against any parameters the team has set for metoprolol.

Bleeding and antiplatelet safety: with clopidogrel plus simvastatin changes, look for bleeding, bruising, melena, hematuria, or new anemia on recent labs; confirm clopidogrel is still indicated per the treating clinician.

Lipid and liver monitoring: check whether a lipid panel or liver enzymes were drawn since the simvastatin change, and whether results are routed to the prescriber. Ask about muscle pain or weakness, which the team should report to the clinician.

Weight and BMI trend: obesity (BMI 30+) and prediabetes are on the problem list. Compare weight over the window with prior values, and check any HbA1c or glucose results and whether they are due for follow-up.

Breast cancer history (dx 1997): check whether surveillance imaging, oncology follow-up, or survivorship visits are due or overdue, and whether any new symptoms or appointments were recorded in the window.
Falls, function, and ADLs: screen for falls or near-falls in the window (age 85, on antiplatelet and beta blocker), changes in ADL or IADL performance, mobility aids, and any new home safety needs.
Cognition, mood, and attendance: review cognitive screening or observations, mood and depression screening, missed PACE center days or appointments, and any change in engagement.
Caregiver and social situation: confirm current caregiver availability and any change in living situation, transportation, or support needs since the last review (enrollment 2025-04-05).

Care-plan items due before the 2026-11-30 review: list any assessments, reassessments, or goals with due dates in or near the window, and flag items that are overdue. Note that the allergy list is empty; confirm it was checked with the participant rather than assumed.
